'''Green Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] that was part of the ''[[Thurse]]''{{'s}} complement. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], it helped protect the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]-[[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] in the [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Bilbringi]].
